title: Tolerating Bud Powell and Charlie Parker half high
summary: As a leader he tolerated great players like Bud Powell who came in half high.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: -- that happen. Well, so in that sense, Cootie, you must have been a little satisfied to have your own band. Because at least anything that was wrong was in your power to maybe do something about. Or, if not, well at least you knew that the only reason you didn't was because you couldn't.

Well, I'll tell you. I used to have musicians, sometimes, would come in and be half high, or something. And I would put up with them. But they were great musicians. And I would let them get by with it. But if the musician wasn't a great musician, he couldn't do that, or else I'd fire him.
Now, like Bud Powell, and those type of people would come in half high and messed up. I'd overlook it. Because when they would be straight, I would get some great sound.
Yeah. Those guys must have appreciated the fact that you had an ear for what they were doing.
